judgment.notes: n is uniquely λ+1. H001 supplies λ≥0, so the stated positive-integer/natural type is legitimate, with n≥1. All R using this convention include H001. It does not assume any module rank conclusion.

The finite natural interval 0≤i≤λ has λ+1=n elements under H001 and includes 0 even when λ=0. Index binders and boundary conventions are consistent throughout N/P and R; H001 is a direct input at each use. The cardinality clause is finite interval counting, not a dimension assumption.

Defines exactly the original divided-power family e_i=y^i v/i! in V, indexed by I. Finite factorial products are positive, hence nonzero in C, including 0!=1. The definition grants neither nonzeroness nor basis status; these are the output N001. Its I guard H001 is available to users.

X_r is the complex operator x^r/r! for every natural r, with X_0 the identity. The denominator is nonzero over C, so definition is total on its stated domain. Reduction does not redefine this by dividing in K for arbitrary r: induced lattice divided powers are used, and the factorial-inverse identification in K is restricted to r≤λ

Y_r=y^r/r! is a well-typed complex endomorphism for every natural r, including the identity at zero; factorials are nonzero in C. Lattice preservation is an H004 consequence proved in R002, not a property smuggled into this definition. Reduced inverse-factorial notation is correctly range-restricted in N004.

U_Z is the integer subalgebra generated by all abstract enveloping divided powers, with their represented actions X,Y on V. This agrees with the original, with no minimal-lattice restriction or integral-basis theorem asserted. Preservation of M is the explicit admissibility hypothesis H004, used directly by the relevant R. The representation extension specifies the meaning of the action, not a new representation-theoretic result.

R is the concrete subring of rational fractions with a denominator not divisible by p, included in C, exactly Z_(p) in the supplied route. H001 ensures prime p (so permitted denominators are nonzero and multiplicatively closed). Unit means an inverse within this subring; no PID, rank-one, or map-to-K result is assumed by the definition. All R users include H001; the latter substantive properties are handled in the R bodies.

The R-span of the additive subgroup M is an unambiguous R-submodule of V, defined by finite sums. This safely distinguishes the concrete submodule from R⊗_Z M: the map on pure tensors is stated, but injectivity is explicitly not assumed. N002 exports the identification produced by R002, and later R003/R004 take N002 directly.

Matrix units E_ij are uniquely specified by their values on the basis e, with δ explicitly defined. The necessary basis guard is N001, and every R using E (R002-R004) lists N001 and H001 directly. Concretely the map takes the j-coordinate of a vector to that scalar times e_i; this is a legitimate basis-dependent linear map. No lattice-preservation property is granted by defining E; that is the separate exported N002.

J_i is the inverse image of M_R under the R-linear map c↦ce_i from C to V, hence closed under addition and R-scalars on its stated domain. This construction does not require e_i≠0. Equalities of these modules, finite generation and nonzeroness are not definitional and are separately claimed in N003. H001 guards I,R in its use.

J=J_0 is well-defined since 0∈I under H001, including λ=0. It inherits precisely the R-submodule type from D010. Equality with other J_i and a nonzero principal generator are outputs of N003, not properties hidden in this alias.

V(K)=M⊗_Z K has the usual balanced tensor-product meaning and induced K-vector-space structure. Additivity and integer balancing are explicit. Overloading x,y,h on this space is expressly conditional on lattice preservation, not inferred from total tensor formation. R004 establishes preservation using direct H002/H004; R005 has those same H inputs. No localization or nonzero tensor theorem is assumed by this definition.

The formal free rank-three Chevalley Z-Lie algebra and all generator brackets are specified, with zero self-brackets before scalar extension. This matches the original Chevalley construction, including characteristic 2 and the trivial λ=0 representation, rather than mistaking operator images for the Lie algebra. The action is the restriction/extension of the given representation after lattice preservation; H002 supplies relations and H004 supplies x,y preservation, so h=xy-yx preserves M as shown in R005. Both H are direct inputs in that consumer. This definition adds no irreducibility assumption.

Factorial is a total natural-number function defined by a finite product with the empty product equal to one. Its product-bound t and argument d are scoped. This agrees with the factorial in the source M007 and yields nonzero complex denominators, but does not assert nonvanishing after reduction; that remains a separate claim using the prime/range conditions.

The natural binomial function is completely defined by counting subsets of a specified finite interval, with its zero and empty-subset cases. Applications with λ are made under H001 so the natural arguments are legitimate. The definition does not assume the factorial ratio or invertibility: R001 displays the finite ordered-list count for the ratio, while R002/R004 handle the unit assertions separately.

Compared the complete original target and fixed five-step proof with the canonical spec and exhaustive H inventory, then all five canonical R bodies for route consistency. H001-H004 preserve primality, characteristic, the full integer range, complex representation/dimension/commutators, the nonzero highest-weight vector, and arbitrary admissibility; none is hidden in parameter types. Under these parameters and H, P is exactly the nonzero invariant-subspace theorem, with the abstract Chevalley interpretation of L(K), not its potentially nonfaithful operator image. The route remains characteristic-zero divided-power coordinates, localized arbitrary-lattice matrix units, tensor rank-one computation and principal generator, reduction/base change, and matrix-unit irreducibility. Endpoint checks: λ=0 has I={0}, identity matrix unit and coefficients 1; p=2 allows λ=0,1 and requires no distinct reduced weights; λ=p-1 still only uses factorials below p. K remains arbitrary, not algebraically closed. This is global A0/A5 target and route review, not a verdict on separate packet replay. Reviewed only the declared frozen task material and pinned sources; no separate reference solution or prior verdict was supplied.
